state.method_context: electronic structure, cc-pVDZ basis, singlet reference
state.geometry_note: all bonds stretched to 1.5 x equilibrium length

mr.instructions: The ground state has strong multireference (static correlation) character: the Hartree-Fock determinant carries less than 90% of the exact wavefunction weight.

unstable.instructions: The RHF solution is unstable: a spin-unrestricted (UHF) solution with lower energy exists.
